caption: The drawing displays three objects: a three-dimensional cast iron box in the center and two rectangular relief panels, one on the left and one on the lower right. The cast iron box is depicted with brown, gold, and bronze hues, featuring accented shadows and highlights. The box is square with ornate corner legs and has text on its visible side that reads “THE BEST KAST IRON CLOTHING.” Within a circular frame on this side are the numbers “15 & 17.” The front panel of the box shows a raised design of a cherub or angelic figure with wings. The top of the box is decorated with intricate patterns. The rectangular panel on the left shows a raised relief of a woman seated beside a lion on a similarly brown and bronze background. The rectangular panel on the lower right depicts a cherub or angelic figure with wings and a cloth draped on a curved object. Both panels echo the metallic, weathered coloration of the box, emphasizing highlights and depth. The objects are illustrated on a plain, off-white background, and there is a small signature in the bottom right reading "W.O. Fletcher."
title: Safe Bank
